verdict.rationale: AiPrise is an API-driven compliance platform, so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for it. The only access-control evidence covers inviting human team members and assigning dashboard roles. That is an adjacent control, not scoped or least-privilege API keys for an agent, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
